name: Sarah Chen
title: Co-founder & CEO
short_description: Bookkeeping and finance operations for early-stage tech companies.
full_bio:
Sarah spent eight years in finance at two Ottawa scale-ups before founding Maple Ledger in 2021. The firm now looks after the books, payroll and grant reporting for more than sixty early-stage companies across the region.

She is a regular mentor at local accelerators and cares most about helping founders understand their numbers early, so that growth decisions are made with confidence rather than guesswork. Outside work she coaches youth hockey and is always up for a coffee along the canal.
